## Type of Change

<!-- Mark one with [x] -->

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to change)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Build / CI / tooling improvement
- [ ] Test addition or improvement

## Description

Describe your changes in detail. Link to any related issues.

## Testing

<!-- Mark one with [x] -->

- [ ] Existing tests pass locally
- [ ] New tests added to cover the changes
- [ ] Manually verified (describe steps)

## Checklist

<!-- Mark one with [x] -->

- [ ] Code follows the project's style guidelines (see CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] Self-reviewed my own code
- [ ] Added or updated relevant documentation
- [ ] No new compiler warnings introduced
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md updated (if applicable)
